card.name: Spaces in ulcer treatment dosing tables
card.fires_on: The space just before a number in dosing tables for duodenal or gastric ulcer treatment, usually the duration (4 weeks, 4 to 8 weeks) after 'once daily for' or 'up to'.

modes.description: Space after 'once daily for' or 'up to' ahead of the number of weeks in an ulcer row.
